subject.title: Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: Governing Board Member, Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District

As your Placentia-Yorba Linda school board trustee, a Certified Public Accountant, and a father of three PYLUSD students, I have worked to put students first and be consistent with the promises I made to our families in 2022. In every decision, I always focus on student interests first.

When I first ran, I pledged fiscal discipline, transparency, and an education system focused on academics rather than politics. On the board, I have applied my CPA training to scrutinize the budget, protect classroom dollars, and hold spending accountable to results, because every dollar counts.
There is still work to do, and I am asking for your vote to continue confronting challenging issues.

I will keep defending parental rights, protect girls' sports, and focus on student success in and outside the classroom. Parents deserve transparency about what is taught in the classroom, timely notifications, and a genuine voice in their children's education. I believe classroom instruction should be academic and age-appropriate so students can focus on reading, writing, math, and critical thinking. Political agendas including CRT and DEI advocated by some local universities have no place in PYLUSD.

Our daughters have a right to compete on a level playing field. I oppose biological males in girls athletic competitions or in girls locker rooms. I will fight to defend these rights, and keep communication between the district and its families open and honest.

As a business owner, I believe our schools should prepare all students for success, not only those bound for a four-year university. I will expand real career pathways in the skilled trades, technology, entrepreneurship, and artificial intelligence, so graduates leave PYLUSD immediately prepared to earn, build, and lead.

For more than thirty years, Yorba Linda has been my home. My wife and I have raised our family here, worshiped here. I have coached and supported local youth sports. I love this community, and our schools should reflect its values: integrity, hard work, and respect for every family.
I would be honored to keep serving you. Thank you for your trust, your prayers, and your vote.
Learn more at voteforfrazier.com.

text: Educator/Businessowner/Parent

My children all graduated from or currently attend Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District schools, just like I did. At Chapman University, I currently teach graduate students and have served as: Assistant Dean
Director of Executive Education
Founding Director of a master’s program in the College of Business and Economics

At the Richard Nixon Foundation, my work includes developing civics education platforms for students from 3rd grade to college and launching the new American Civics Academy to expand civics education nationally. I worked for Governor Pete Wilson, helping launch California’s landmark 1996 Class Size Reduction Initiative.

As a former Mayor, I championed reopening an elementary school and authored a civic history book and engagement program for 3rd graders. Even in college, I cared deeply about education policy, serving on the California State University System Board of Trustees.

I’m a concerned parent, educator, taxpayer, and small business owner who is profoundly worried about the state of the Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District: outstanding teachers leaving, ongoing budget deficits, and frequent leadership turnover. Cal State Fullerton is so concerned that they’ve stopped placing student teachers in Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District schools.

If elected as your Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District
Trustee, I will:
Protect academic opportunities
Recruit and retain great teachers
Prioritize special education
Strengthen school safety
Restore fiscal stability
Please vote for Chris Lowe for Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District. www.loweforpylusd.com

text: Business Owner
I want to represent you, your student, and our community because it matters. Students matter. Families matter. Educators matter. Community matters. Integrity matters.

I have been a proud resident and dedicated community advocate of Yorba Linda since 1997, and small business owner since 1998. My husband, Jim, and I have been married for over 30 years. Together, we founded Jim Buckley and Associates, an independent insurance adjusting firm, where I manage budgets, contracts, benefits, payroll, and human resources. We raised our two children through PYLUSD, from Fairmont Elementary to Bernardo Yorba Middle School to Yorba Linda High School. Our daughter Emely is now a kindergarten teacher, and our son Jimmy is an engineer.

For over 15 years, I have served our schools and community as founder of Making a Difference, a nonprofit providing food, school supplies, and financial support to local families in need, as a board member of Homeless Intervention Services of Orange County and Placentia Yorba Meals on Wheels, and serving through many local organizations such as Love Yorba Linda and Charity’s Closet. My work with PTA units across our district has been recognized with multiple California State PTA service awards. This hands-on experience has given me a clear understanding of what our students, teachers, and families truly need, and how to get things done for them.

I am running for every student to ensure each child receives an excellent education that prepares them for a successful future. We must come together in support of our students, teachers, and administrators. This is not us versus them. When leadership falls short, we should make thoughtful changes, but tearing down our educators helps no one; instead, let us be their advocates and partners.

With our district facing declining enrollment and potential budget cuts - while operating at a deficit, fiscal responsibility must be a top priority. Drawing on my business experience, I will reassess spending and contracts, and will pursue renegotiations and competitive bidding to secure cost-effective solutions, while protecting class sizes and jobs. I am ready to roll up my sleeves and do the hard work required.

In today's climate, we must focus on what is best for our students and community, not on party agendas, sound bites, or culture wars. With your support, experience, integrity, and dedication, I will bring steady, student-first leadership to our school board.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
